reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering fishing tackle, trash and treasure items, tree fertilizer, an artifact, quest clothing, drinks and foods, a festival token, and truffles were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary, event and recipe names, fishing behavior, treasure spawning, tree-growth restrictions, object gender, quest-item humor, and reward instructions; both found no remaining objective issue.

TrapBobber_Description.source: Causes fish to escape slower when you aren't reeling them in.
TrapBobber_Description.translation: Peștii scapă mai încet când nu tragi de fir.

TreasureChest_Description.source: Wow, it's loaded with treasure! This is sure to fetch a good price.
TreasureChest_Description.translation: Uau, este plin de comori! Sigur se va vinde la un preț bun.

TreasureHunter_Description.source: Fish don't escape while collecting treasures. Also slightly increases the chance to find treasures.
TreasureHunter_Description.translation: Peștii nu scapă cât timp aduni comori. Mărește și puțin șansa de a găsi comori.

TreasureTotem_Description.source: Use on diggable terrain to summon a ring of treasure spots.
TreasureTotem_Description.translation: Folosește-l pe un teren care poate fi săpat pentru a invoca un cerc de locuri cu comori.

TreeFertilizer_Description.source: Sprinkle on a wild tree to ensure rapid growth, even in winter. Doesn't work on fruit trees.
TreeFertilizer_Description.translation: Presară-l pe un copac sălbatic pentru a-i asigura creșterea rapidă, chiar și iarna. Nu funcționează pe pomii fructiferi.

Trilobite_Description.source: A long extinct relative of the crab.
Trilobite_Description.translation: O rudă a crabului dispărută de mult.

TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Name.translation: Pantaloni scurți mov norocoși cu bordură

TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.source: Purple silk shorts trimmed in luxurious gold...
TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.translation: Pantaloni scurți din mătase mov, cu o bordură luxoasă din aur...

TripleShotEspresso_Description.source: It's more potent than regular coffee!
TripleShotEspresso_Description.translation: Este mai puternic decât cafeaua obișnuită!

TropicalCurry_Description.source: An exotic, fragrant curry served in a pineapple bowl.
TropicalCurry_Description.translation: Un curry exotic și parfumat, servit într-un bol de ananas.

TroutDerbyTag_Description.source: Turn this in to the Trout Derby booth for a reward.
TroutDerbyTag_Description.translation: Predă-o la standul Derbiului Păstrăvilor pentru o recompensă.
